name: Ransom Pringle

events.title: Children
events.description: Ida A. (b. 1861); Henry A. (b. 9 Jun 1864, Beach Haven; d. 1940).

bioAdditions: FamilySearch tree KL4L-RDD calls him George Ransom Pringle, born April 1829 at Plymouth to Samuel D. Pringle and Hulda Ives. He married Mary C. Stookey (1842-1898), and their children were Ida A. (b. 1861) and Henry A. (b. Beach Haven 9 Jun 1864, d. 1940). He was in Plymouth Twp. in 1870 and died in Hunlock Twp. in April 1880 (S1). The tree attaches an entry in the 1880 PA mortality schedule, which counts deaths in the census year ending 31 May 1880. That is a contemporary record of his death and fits Munsell's 'leading merchant' at Hunlock Creek.

conflicts.foundValue: FS: 'Charles Evans Cemetery, Reading, Berks Co.'
conflicts.assessment: Burial at Reading is unlikely for a man who died in Hunlock Twp. The Find a Grave index entry may belong to another George R. Pringle. Unverified.
